methods.name: Proposed 2-order network with matrix multiplication
methods.protocol_description: A reduced 2-order network containing scaled identity operator and a single quadratic operation (matrix multiplication). It interleaves MLPs applied to the feature dimension and matrix multiplication. Architectures tested: (1) b=400, d=2, suffix (ii); (2) b=400, d=2, suffix (i); (3) b=256, d=3, suffix (ii). Suffix (i): invariant max pooling (diagonal and off-diagonal) followed by three FC layers (512, 256, #classes). Suffix (ii): invariant max layer applied to output of every block, then a single FC layer to #classes, outputs summed. For QM9, used network (2) with absolute error loss. Parameter search: learning rate in {5e-5, 1e-4, 5e-4, 1e-3}, learning rate decay in [0.5, 1] every 20 epochs. For classification, 10-fold CV with best averaged accuracy; for regression, 80/10/10 split, best validation error.
